product_one_liner.value: Karbon is an AI-powered practice-management platform for accounting firms that brings client work, workflows, communication, documents, and billing together in one place.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as practice-management software built for accounting firms.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing plans and prices are listed.

named_customers.notes: All three are named in Karbon's customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists San Francisco, California as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and Karbon's company origin story identify 2014 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Karbon has a content/blog site and a technology category, but the engineering-focused post found is a hackathon article; the available index evidence did not establish at least two posts on product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data, incidents, or open source.

public_docs.notes: Karbon links to a public API Developer Center and product help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists openings, but none of the listed titles is AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: Karbon's Kai announcement describes its AI capabilities but does not name an underlying model or provider; no provider was identified in the product/security information reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: Karbon says its web application is SOC 2 Type II certified and states it adheres to GDPR. It says its ISO 27001-aligned ISMS is not independently certified; PCI DSS is attributed to Stripe, not Karbon.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights identifies Karbon's latest funding round as a $10.5 million Series B - II dated September 18, 2023.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in September 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists roles, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Karbon announced Kai on June 3, 2026, and its release notes show product updates through October 26, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page identifies its listed executive and VP team, and the dated appointment announcement found for Twyla Verhelst is May 28, 2025, before the 12-month window; no in-window C-level/VP join or departure was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Karbon's integration pages name HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Intuit Mailchimp.
